WITH scope_counts AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u
    ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  order_count,
  1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
  1.0 * order_count / AVG(order_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM scope_counts;
